name: lens
description: Lens: cross-platform auto-polishing screen recorder (clean-room Screen Studio / FocuSee feature parity)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lens/engine && npm run build -w @lens/cli && npm run build -w @lens/editor
scripts.test: npm test -w @lens/engine && npm test -w @lens/cli && npm test -w @lens/editor
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lens/engine && npm run typecheck -w @lens/cli && npm run typecheck -w @lens/editor
